options.content: Physical UCM storage calls and backend diagnostics for HiCache and direct Linker. Call count and duration include failures; pages, bytes and bandwidth describe successful calls only. HiCache records per physical pool call; Linker records per pool/layer shard. Neither is inference request count or deduplicated logical page count. Each worker reports its own transferred data. HiCache currently selects Posix; Linker supports its configured pipeline, including Cache|Posix. Cache task completion does not imply downstream Posix persistence. Store task byte/duration metrics can include failed tasks. Multiple Store groups share per-worker Counter/Histogram series; existing same-name Gauges do not identify groups and must not be interpreted as total capacity or all-group health. Shared-resource observations across workers must not be summed blindly. Missing series remain No data.

panels.title: Storage call rate
panels.description: Physical storage calls attempted, including failures. One call can cover multiple pages; this is not inference request rate.

panels.title: Successful transfer throughput
panels.description: Successful bytes per second over the selected rate window, including idle time. Values are local to each worker.

panels.title: Storage submission and completion failures
panels.description: Failed calls per second, separated by load/dump and submit/wait. Missing series means no sample has been emitted; it is not replaced with zero.

panels.title: Mean storage call duration
panels.description: Mean time from storage submission to confirmed completion, including failed attempts. Excludes earlier queueing, buffer preparation and restoration.

panels.description:
指标与代码位置：
- `ucm:posix_load_queue_wait_duration_ms`：Load 任务从提交到开始执行 IO 的排队时间。AIO 位置：`ucm/store/posix/cc/io_engine_aio.h` / `IoEngineAio::Dispatch` / IO 分发前；PSYNC 位置：`ucm/store/posix/cc/trans_queue.cc` / `TransQueue::LoadWorker` / 首个 IO unit 开始时。
- `ucm:posix_load_task_duration_ms`：Load 任务端到端耗时。位置：`ucm/store/posix/cc/io_engine_aio.h` / `IoEngineAio::Dispatch`，以及 `ucm/store/posix/cc/io_engine_psync.h` / `IoEnginePsync::Dispatch` / waiter 完成回调。
`task after queue` 为总耗时减去排队时间后的估算值。

targets.expr:
clamp_min(
  (
    sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(${ucm_prefix}posix_load_task_duration_ms_sum{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",model_name=~"$model_name",worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[40s]))
    /
    sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(${ucm_prefix}posix_load_task_duration_ms_count{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",model_name=~"$model_name",worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[40s]))
  )
  -
  (
    sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(${ucm_prefix}posix_load_queue_wait_duration_ms_sum{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",model_name=~"$model_name",worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[40s]))
    /
    sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(${ucm_prefix}posix_load_queue_wait_duration_ms_count{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",model_name=~"$model_name",worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[40s]))
  ),
  0
)

panels.description:
- `queue wait`：指标 `ucm:cache_load_queue_wait_duration_ms`；Load 任务从提交到调度线程取出的等待时间。代码位置：`ucm/store/cache/cc/load_queue.cc` / `LoadQueue::DispatchOneTask` / 开始处理任务时。
- `backend submit`：指标 `ucm:cache_load_backend_submit_duration_ms`；分配 Cache buffer 并向下层 Store 提交 Load 的耗时。代码位置：`ucm/store/cache/cc/load_queue.cc` / `LoadQueue::DispatchOneTask` / shard 分发完成后。
- `backend wait`：指标 `ucm:cache_shard_backend_wait_ms`；单个 Load shard 等待 Cache buffer 或下层 Load 任务就绪的时间。代码位置：`ucm/store/cache/cc/load_queue.cc` / `LoadQueue::TransferOneTask` / `WaitBackendTaskReady` 返回后。
- `H2D sync`：指标 `ucm:cache_h2d_sync_ms`；最后一组 shard 的 H2D stream 同步耗时。代码位置：`ucm/store/cache/cc/load_queue.cc` / `LoadQueue::RecordH2dSyncMetrics` / stream 同步完成后。
- `h2d submit & other`：计算方法 `Load 总耗时 - queue wait - backend submit - backend wait - H2D sync`；总耗时扣除其他分段平均耗时后的估算值。总耗时代码位置：`ucm/store/cache/cc/trans_manager.h` / `TransManager::Dispatch` / waiter 完成回调。

指标与代码位置：
- `ucm:cache_dump_queue_wait_duration_ms`：Dump 任务从提交到调度线程取出的等待时间。位置：`ucm/store/cache/cc/dump_queue.cc` / `DumpQueue::DispatchOneTask` / 开始处理任务时。
- `ucm:cache_dump_mkbuf_duration_ms`：准备 Cache buffer 并提交 D2H 异步拷贝的耗时。位置：`ucm/store/cache/cc/dump_queue.cc` / `DumpQueue::DumpOneTask` / buffer 准备完成后。

- `ucm:cache_dump_duration_ms`：Dump 任务端到端耗时。位置：`ucm/store/cache/cc/trans_manager.h` / `TransManager::Dispatch` / waiter 完成回调。
`other` 为总耗时减去前四项平均耗时后的估算值。

- `ucm:mooncake_dump_blocks_total`：累计完成写出的 block 数。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/trans_manager.cc` / `TransManager::Dispatch` / Dump waiter 完成回调。
本面板展示两个 Counter 的每秒增速。
panels.title: Mooncake Block Rate

panels.description:
指标与代码位置：
- `ucm:mooncake_load_bytes_total`：Mooncake Load 任务累计逻辑字节数。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/trans_manager.cc` / `TransManager::Dispatch` / Load waiter 完成回调。
- `ucm:mooncake_dump_bytes_total`：Mooncake Dump 任务累计逻辑字节数。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/trans_manager.cc` / `TransManager::Dispatch` / Dump waiter 完成回调。
- `ucm:mooncake_h2d_bytes_total`：累计 H2D 拷贝字节数。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/load_queue.cc` / `LoadQueue::RecordH2dMetrics`，以及 `ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/share_load_queue.cc` / `ShareLoadQueue::RecordH2dMetrics` / stream 同步完成后。
- `ucm:mooncake_d2h_bytes_total`：累计 D2H 拷贝字节数。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/dump_queue.cc` / `DumpQueue::RecordD2hMetrics` / stream 同步完成后。
本面板展示各 Counter 的每秒字节增速。
panels.title: Mooncake Byte Rate

panels.description:
指标与代码位置：
- `ucm:mooncake_load_hit_shards_total`：Mooncake 直接加载命中的 shard 数。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/load_queue.cc` / `LoadQueue::DispatchOneTask` / `batch_get` 结果统计后。
- `ucm:mooncake_load_miss_shards_total`：Mooncake 加载未命中的 shard 数。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/load_queue.cc` / `LoadQueue::DispatchOneTask` / `batch_get` 结果统计后。
- `ucm:mooncake_load_backend_shards_total`：未命中后提交给下层 Store 的 shard 数。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/load_queue.cc` / `LoadQueue::SubmitMissShards`，以及 `ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/share_load_queue.cc` / `ShareLoadQueue::HandleLoadTask` / 下层 Load 提交成功后。
本面板展示各 Counter 的每秒增速。
panels.title: Mooncake Load Hit / Miss Shards

panels.description:
指标与代码位置：
- `ucm:mooncake_dump_existing_shards_total`：Dump 前检查到已存在于 Mooncake 的 shard 数。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/dump_queue.cc` / `DumpQueue::DumpOneTask` / `batchIsExist` 结果统计后。
- `ucm:mooncake_dump_missing_shards_total`：Dump 前检查到 Mooncake 中不存在的 shard 数。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/dump_queue.cc` / `DumpQueue::DumpOneTask` / `batchIsExist` 结果统计后。
- `ucm:mooncake_dump_backend_shards_total`：同时提交给下层 Store 的 shard 数。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/dump_queue.cc` / `DumpQueue::SubmitBackendDump` / 下层 Dump 提交成功后。
本面板展示各 Counter 的每秒增速。
panels.title: Mooncake Dump Existing / Missing Shards

- `ucm:mooncake_dump_duration_ms`：Mooncake Dump 任务端到端耗时。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/trans_manager.cc` / `TransManager::Dispatch` / Dump waiter 完成回调。

- `ucm:mooncake_dump_bandwidth_gbps`：单个 Mooncake Dump 任务的字节数除以端到端耗时所得带宽。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/trans_manager.cc` / `TransManager::Dispatch` / Dump waiter 完成回调。

panels.description:
指标与代码位置：
- `ucm:mooncake_load_queue_wait_duration_ms`：Load 任务排队时间。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/load_queue.cc` / `LoadQueue::DispatchOneTask` / 开始处理任务时。
- `ucm:mooncake_get_duration_ms`：调用 Mooncake `batch_get` 的耗时。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/load_queue.cc` / `LoadQueue::TryMooncakeLoad` / 调用返回后。
- `ucm:mooncake_load_backend_submit_duration_ms`：向下层 Store 提交 Load 的耗时。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/load_queue.cc` / `LoadQueue::SubmitMissShards`，以及 `ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/share_load_queue.cc` / `ShareLoadQueue::HandleLoadTask` / 下层 Load 返回后。
- `ucm:mooncake_backend_load_wait_duration_ms`：等待下层 Load 完成的耗时。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/load_queue.cc` / `LoadQueue::TransferOneTask`，以及 `ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/share_load_queue.cc` / `ShareLoadQueue::HandleBackendComplete` / `backend_->Wait` 返回后。
- `ucm:mooncake_h2d_duration_ms`：H2D stream 同步耗时。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/load_queue.cc` / `LoadQueue::RecordH2dMetrics`，以及 `ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/share_load_queue.cc` / `ShareLoadQueue::RecordH2dMetrics` / stream 同步完成后。
panels.title: Mooncake Load Stage Avg Breakdown

panels.description:
指标与代码位置：
- `ucm:mooncake_dump_queue_wait_duration_ms`：Dump 任务排队时间。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/dump_queue.cc` / `DumpQueue::DispatchOneTask` / 开始处理任务时。
- `ucm:mooncake_exists_duration_ms`：调用 Mooncake `batchIsExist` 的耗时。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/dump_queue.cc` / `DumpQueue::DumpOneTask` / 调用返回后。
- `ucm:mooncake_dump_prereq_wait_ms`：等待前置计算事件的耗时。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/dump_queue.cc` / `DumpQueue::WaitPrerequisite` / 事件同步返回后。
- `ucm:mooncake_d2h_duration_ms`：D2H stream 同步耗时。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/dump_queue.cc` / `DumpQueue::RecordD2hMetrics` / stream 同步完成后。
- `ucm:mooncake_put_duration_ms`：调用 Mooncake `batch_put` 的耗时。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/dump_queue.cc` / `DumpQueue::PutToMooncake` / 调用返回后。
- `ucm:mooncake_dump_backend_submit_duration_ms`：向下层 Store 提交 Dump 的耗时。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/dump_queue.cc` / `DumpQueue::SubmitBackendDump` / `backend_->Dump` 返回后。
- `ucm:mooncake_dump_backend_wait_duration_ms`：等待下层 Dump 完成的耗时。位置：`ucm/store/mooncakestore/cc/dump_queue.cc` / `DumpQueue::BackendDumpStage` / `backend_->Wait` 返回后。
